posts.en:
agent_team_gui is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Reusable agent squads with per-agent provider/model routes and tool policies, serial/parallel dispatch, spawn/fork/chain context modes, and a Web management panel.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-db5f477866921cb988d1.html
